title: Persona audience
description: A declared test population for survey-agent `pretest`. The recommended form is an object with weighted `segments`; a bare list of personas or a single persona also validate. TESTING only — not a real sample.

n.description: total respondents to allocate across segments by weight

persona.description: One persona (or a segment of them, with `weight`).

traits.description: freeform key→value profile (string/number); drives LLM role-play + fuzzy coherence. Use values resembling your option text, e.g. {"usage": "never", "age": 34}.

answers.description: EXACT answers keyed by question id, validated by the engine (wins over traits). Best practice for a real-data source. Value matches the question's option value / number / text.
